title: System Integration Consultant
description:
**Company Description** 
 TechGuard Labs Foundation is a joint Israel–India cybersecurity center established in 2026 in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, by leading academic and industry partners including SNR Sons Trust, Ariel University, ERA IT Consulting \& Audit Ltd, and Promitei Ltd. The center combines proven Israeli cybersecurity methodologies and assessment techniques with deep Indian expertise to strengthen cyber resilience for enterprise, institutional, and public sector organizations. TechGuard operates across the full cybersecurity lifecycle, including risk and readiness assessment, governance, continuous monitoring, incident response, and recovery. Anchored in India and supported by international partners, the organization is committed to adapting to evolving regulatory, threat, and technology environments. TechGuard values excellence in strategy, compliance, technology, and talent to deliver robust cyber\-resilience solutions.
 



**Role Description** 
 The System Integration Consultant is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Greater Coimbatore Area. This role is responsible for assessing client business processes and technical environments, designing integration architectures, and implementing secure, scalable connections between cybersecurity platforms, enterprise applications, and infrastructure components. The consultant collaborates with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, map data flows, configure interfaces, and validate end\-to\-end system performance. Day\-to\-day activities include conducting technical and functional analyses, preparing integration and migration plans, coordinating implementation timelines, and supporting testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer. The consultant also provides ongoing advisory support to clients, helping them optimize integrated solutions for resilience, compliance, and operational efficiency.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong analytical skills to evaluate complex systems, data flows, and cybersecurity requirements.
* Consulting experience, including stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, and solution recommendation.
* Hands\-on integration skills across applications, platforms, and infrastructure, with familiarity in APIs, middleware, and data mapping.
* Project management capabilities to plan, coordinate, and track integration initiatives, including timelines, risks, and deliverables.
* Business process understanding to align technical solutions with organizational workflows and compliance needs.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, standards, and best practices (e.g., network security, identity and access management, incident response) is highly beneficial.
* Experience working with enterprise systems (such as ERP, CRM, SIEM, SOAR, or cloud platforms) and integration tools is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; relevant certifications in integration, cybersecurity, or project management are a plus.
* Effective communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and with external partners.
* Willingness to work on\-site

title: Technical Trainer for Embedded, IoT & Robotics
description:
**Company Description** 

 To empower students, institutions, and aspiring innovators with practical, industry\-relevant technical skills. We focus on delivering hands\-on training in emerging technologies such as Robotics, IoT, AI, Embedded Systems, and advanced engineering domains, ensuring learners gain real\-world exposure beyond traditional classroom education. Our mission is to bridge the gap between academic learning and industry requirements by creating an ecosystem of innovation, creativity, and problem\-solving. We aim to nurture future\-ready talent by providing access to quality training, modern tools, and expert mentorship, enabling individuals to transform ideas into impactful solutions
 




  





**Role Description** 
 The Technical Trainer for Embedded, IoT \& Robotics is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Coimbatore. This role involves designing and delivering training programs on embedded systems, IoT platforms, and robotics hardware to students, customers, and internal team members. Daily responsibilities include preparing instructional materials, conducting hands\-on workshops, demonstrating the use of microcontrollers, sensors, development boards, and robotics kits, and guiding learners through practical projects. The trainer will assess participant skill levels, provide feedback, and continuously improve training content based on learner outcomes and emerging technologies. Collaboration with sales, support, and product teams is expected to align training with customer needs and product capabilities.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Conduct technical training for school and college students
* Deliver hands\-on training in electronics, embedded systems, IoT, robotics, automation and related technologies
* Optimize training curriculum, modules, presentations and practical exercises
* Prepare and maintain training kits, hardware demo setups for training
* Conduct practical demonstrations, workshops and lab sessions
* Guide participants in projects, prototypes and problem\-solving
* Evaluate learning through assignments, practical tests and projects
* Develop new training programs based on industry requirements
* Handle advanced technical queries during training
* Maintain training quality, feedback and improvement reports
* Support the pre\-sales team with technical demonstrations and solution discussions
* Regularly work on and support student prototype development activities
* Encourage and guide students to participate in competitions and hackathons
* Mentor students on development work related to their projects and prototypes
* Be ready for field work/travel related to training programs as required in and around overall Tamil Nadu

title: Subject Matter Expert
description:
**Company Description** 
 Dareon Private Limited is a next\-generation IT\-enabled services and digital publishing company focused on ePublishing, content transformation, AI\-assisted workflow automation, media production, and professional voice solutions. The company supports publishers, educational institutions, enterprises, startups, and other organizations in digitizing, structuring, enriching, and distributing content across platforms and devices. Its expertise includes OCR processing, XML conversion, ePub development, accessibility compliance, multimedia production, and digital media solutions built for evolving digital ecosystems. By combining technology, creativity, and intelligent automation, Dareon delivers scalable, future\-ready digital experiences and end\-to\-end content solutions. Team members have the opportunity to work with diverse global clients and cutting\-edge digital workflows.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Subject Matter Expert (SME) is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Coimbatore. The SME will provide domain expertise for digital publishing and IT\-enabled services projects, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and consistency of content and workflows. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include reviewing and validating project requirements, defining standards and best practices, guiding teams on content structure and quality, and collaborating with production, technology, and quality assurance teams to resolve complex issues. The SME will develop documentation, training materials, and guidelines to support internal teams, and may participate in client discussions to clarify specifications and recommend solutions. The role also involves continuous learning to stay current with industry trends, tools, and standards related to ePublishing, accessibility, and digital media.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong expertise in digital publishing, ePublishing workflows, and content transformation for multi\-platform delivery.

title: AMM Author
description:
AMM Author \| 7 years To 14 years \| Coimbatore

* Your attention to detail, commitment to quality, and ability to deliver within tight timelines make you a reliable contributor to any aerospace documentation team.

title: Content Editor And Marketer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Content Editor \& Marketer — AI\-First Search (SEO/AEO)
 



**Department:** 
 Marketing
 



**Location:** 
 Coimbatore (Work from Office)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience Level:** 
 2\+ years
 



  





**Company Overview** 




**Cartrabbit builds customer retention software for eCommerce businesses — loyalty programs, reviews, referrals, and email marketing tools — used by 50,000\+ merchants worldwide across Shopify and WooCommerce. We are a product\-first SaaS company based in Coimbatore, competing globally from day one.** 




  





**Role Summary** 




**We are looking for a Content Editor \& Marketer to own our visibility across both traditional and AI\-driven search. This role combines classic SEO with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — ensuring our content ranks on Google, is featured in AI Overviews, and is cited by tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini when users search for related products and solutions.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and execute SEO and AEO strategies to improve organic visibility on search engines and AI\-generated answers.
* Structure content with clear entity definitions, direct answers, schema markup, and comparison\-friendly formats optimized for both search algorithms and AI models.
* Monitor and track how Cartrabbit's products are represented in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews; identify gaps versus competitors and address them.
* Use AI writing and research tools to draft and scale content production, while applying strong editorial judgment to ensure quality and accuracy.
* Edit and review all published content to maintain a consistent brand voice, eliminate unnecessary filler, and ensure all claims are supported by data or sources.
* Conduct competitive content analysis to identify ranking and citation opportunities, and develop content to capture them.
* Collaborate with product and marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 2\+ years of content writing/editing experience in B2B SaaS, preferably in eCommerce, retail technology, or marketing tools.
* Working knowledge of AEO/GEO principles — how AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity select and cite sources — or strong aptitude to learn quickly.
* Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals: keyword research, search intent analysis, on\-page optimization, and schema markup.
* Proficiency with AI writing/research tools and SEO platforms such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, and GA4\.
* A portfolio demonstrating content that has ranked, converted, or been cited by AI tools, with supporting performance data.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to consistently meet content deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience building or contributing to an AEO/GEO strategy from the ground up.
* Familiarity with the eCommerce SaaS competitive landscape.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct access to founders and leadership with minimal approval layers.
* Ownership of a measurable function — rankings, AI citations, traffic, and signups tied directly to your work.
* Opportunity to build a new discipline (AEO) within the company from scratch.



  





**Application Process** 




  





**Candidates should submit:** 



1. A portfolio of three content pieces they consider their best work, with one line on the measurable outcome of each (ranking, citation, conversion, etc.).
2. (Optional but preferred) One example of a query where AI search engines currently give an inaccurate answer about our product category, along with a brief explanation of how they would correct it.



  





 Apply \> hr@humbletree.io

title: On-site Technology Senior Support Specialist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**On\-site Technology Senior Support Specialist**
**(Senior Associate)**
**Enterprise Technology (ET)**
 Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.
   

  

 Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 As part of Enterprise Technology, the On\-site Technology Support’s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service.
   

  

 The On\-site Technology Support Senior Specialist provides this support to customers within the country or site by performing the highest level of multiple technology support activities. This professional provides meaningful contributions to team efforts to enhance effectiveness; acts creatively to prioritize tasks; interprets information; and applies technical knowledge to satisfy customer and firm objectives. This professional anticipates technology support issues and creates solutions with appropriate consultation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Facilitate and support the deployment of hardware and software to end users (including the installation, configuration and testing of more complex firm hardware).
* Assist with (or coordinate) the repair of end user hardware and the reinstallation of software as necessary to resolve end user incidents.
* Resolve complex incidents associated with firm\-standard end user software and hardware, including mobile/hand\-held technologies. Identify sources and trends of technical problems to prevent future occurrences.
* Acts as a lead to less experienced specialists
* Provide after\-hours service for escalated issues or tasks from the Service Desk or supervisor.
* Perform asset management activities (procurement, receipt, inventory, tracking, distribution, etc.) as assigned and in accordance with firm policy and EY Technology process.
* Anticipates technology support issues and acts to creatively to prioritize tasks, interpret solutions and apply knowledge to facilitate the development and implementation of technical business solutions to complex customer technology needs and issues
* Works independently on small projects and assesses the local needs of area offices and responds appropriately
* Document and track the status of enquiries, coordinate appropriate responses and follow\-up to ensure customer satisfaction
* Work effectively as “remote hands” for other EY Technology functions, such as Telecommunications and Hosting.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of EY Technology’s organization and service offerings in order to identify how best to address end user technology needs and incidents.
* Understand the Firm’s business and organization sufficiently to anticipate and resolve end user technology issues that affect productivity of Firm personnel
* This role is required to physically work in an EY office.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Advanced analytical skills are required to address end\-user incidents escalated from the service desk or offered by end user on walk\-up issues.
* Decision making responsibilities can be made to address issues impacting large numbers of customers within the supported geography and communicate effectively to customers as necessary.
* Experience in leading projects and overseeing contribution and performance of project members
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience is desirable.


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, organizational, project and time management skills.
* Excellent customer service attitude.
* Demonstrated multitasking abilities in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to liaise and work effectively with all levels of end users and IT personnel.
* Ability to communicate effectively with supervisor and peers.
* Approximately 4\-8 years of extensive experience in end user software and hardware and technology support


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
